title: PvP fixes
text:
Rage and the hunter's wolf now work against players.

🔧 Barbarians and Bulwarks now build rage from auto-attacks on players in the arena and Emberclash Fields, the same as on monsters. Before, rage in PvP only came from taking hits
🔧 The hunter's wolf now attacks enemy players you target in the arena and the battleground, using the same PvP damage rules as you. It never attacks teammates
